description: Owner-only. Removes a member from your team by their user id (see get_org_status for the list) — their access to team tools/limits is revoked immediately, but their own personal Patlas account is unaffected.

confirm.description: Must be exactly true. Removing a member immediately revokes their access to this org's tools/limits — only set true after explicitly confirming with the caller which member they mean.
